clips.title: The story
paras: This quest sends adventurers to recover Blind Mary's discarded looking glass for the astronomer Viktori Prism'Antras. The fragile mirror fell into the hands of an Insane Ghoul that wanders the desolate Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in southern Duskwood.

Before the creeping gloom overran Duskwood and turned her into a weeping spirit, Blind Mary treasured an ornate looking glass. Following the horrific incident that claimed her sight and sanity, she cast the keepsake into the dirt behind her family barn. The reflective mirror is exactly what Viktori Prism'Antras needs to build his grand telescope in Darkshire, but it was snatched away into the shadows long before the astronomer dreamed of studying the heavens.

The mirror was scavenged by an Insane Ghoul that prowled behind the ruined farmsteads. Driven south by restless hunger, the wretched undead creature carried the looking glass into the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, haunting an abandoned chapel amid the overgrown tombstones. Reclaiming the delicate lens means navigating the flesh-eating horrors that infest the southern woods to pry Mary's lost treasure from rotting claws.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until... The incident. After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn. There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there. Perhaps he picked it up. Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. He was impressed. Did you happen to find a reflective device?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
